description: AI watches a TikTok (frames + captions) and suggests counting questions with their answers and the evidence for each — high confidence only. Creates nothing. Costs 40 credits, charged only when questions come back. Show every question WITH its evidence to the user and pass only the ones they confirm to create_watch_quiz (or boost_post's watch_quiz). If it fails, nothing is charged — ask the user for questions instead.
name: suggest_quiz_questions
title: Suggest watch-quiz questions from a TikTok
